about: Measurements taken while the engine was built, before the frozen evaluation. Practice figures use a separate set of 22 questions, including 19 with an answer passage, plus invented exposure questions. They never use the frozen evaluation set.

versions.name: Hybrid retrieval, top 6
versions.change: 68 pages chosen by a section rule, 315 passages; keyword (FTS5/BM25) and vector search fused by reciprocal-rank fusion; the model sees the top 6 passages

versions.name: Top 8, scored by the answer passage
versions.change: retrieval judged by whether the passage holding the answer is retrieved, not just its page; top 6 raised to top 8

versions.name: Verified answers
versions.change: the model returns claims with exact quotes; deterministic checks remove any claim whose quote, numbers or regulation names are not in its passage; fixed texts for refusals and emergencies

versions.name: Model-read emergencies
versions.change: a separate first model request decides whether the question describes an exposure (no retrieval if yes); evidence-only verification; only finished, schema-exact replies are used

versions.name: Reranked retrieval (deployed)
versions.change: a BGE cross-encoder reorders the fused top 20 and the model sees the top 8

retrieval_practice.note: An earlier check counted a hit whenever any passage from the right page was retrieved. It showed no difference between the settings and was withdrawn because it scored wrong passages as hits.

model_benchmark.note: Practice set, same saved passages for every model; the 18 answerable answers were graded by a frontier LLM judge.

emergency_detection.note: Exposures: invented questions describing a product swallowed, in the eyes or on the skin. Look-alikes: ordinary building or safety questions that must not be referred. The last 20 + 20 of each were written before step 2 was built and held out.
emergency_detection.phrase_list: the v3 phrase list missed 7 of 8 realistic exposures and flagged 7 of 8 building questions; widened rules then caught 6 of 12 exposures on questions written afterwards

emergency_detection.held_out: on the 20 + 20 held-out questions all three models referred 20/20 exposures and 0/20 look-alikes

reranker_practice.note: Practice set, three models, fused top 8 versus BGE-reranked top 8; 22 answers per run were graded by a frontier LLM judge as sound / partial / wrong.

reranker_held_out.note: 23 questions written before any run to test spelling variants, synonyms, vague and misspelt wording. Rank of the best answering passage in the top 8 the model sees; null = not in the top 8.
